column1: # Single source of truth for the 16 apps. Extracted verbatim from the old
# were two copies that had to be kept in sync by hand.
# dir            = shell project directory ("-" for the hub, which IS tactics_board/)
# bundle         = iOS bundle id AND Android applicationId (must never change:
#                  a different id is a different app on both stores)
# name_en/zh/ja  = CFBundleDisplayName / android app_name per locale
# admob_ios      = AdMob *application* id (~ form) for iOS, "-" when the app
#                  ships ad-free (its plist then keeps Google's sample id)
# admob_android  = same for Android; only 4 apps have an Android AdMob app
